more_info.overview: Sucrose acetate isobutyrate is used as a flavour enhancer in food. Its technological role is to strengthen flavours already present in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use estimates were below the limit.
Animal chronic and reproductive studies found no effects at the highest tested dose used to derive the limit.
